title: A doubling stops at 999 Attack or Health
notes: R4079000: Unsecure System's doubling and Divine Spirit's doubling or tripling take a Unit's stat no higher than MULTIPLIED_STAT_CAP (999), after ten doublings in handicapped fuzz seed 9203 reached 3,066 Attack, past GROWTH_NUMBER_BOUND; the v0.6.6d scripts are kept for replays (R767000).

player.title: Doubling capped at 999
changes: Unsecure System and Divine Spirit now raise a Unit's Attack or Health to at most 999.
